tha-ap209:2.1: advejjhaṁ → abejjhaṁ (sya-all) | dhanuṁ advejjhaṁ → dhanum adejjhaṁ (pts) | adejjhaṁ → G. adecchaṁ; vḷ. adajjhaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap209:2.2: sannayhahaṁ → sandhāyahaṁ (sya-all, pts) | usuṁ → G. ussuṁ. (pts note) | sandhāy → G. saddāy'. (pts note)
tha-ap209:2.3: savaṇṭaṁ → savaṇaṭaṁ (bj) | savaṇṭaṁ → G. savandaṁ; S1 savanthaṁ; S2 vasaṇṭhaṁ; vḷ. vasantaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap209:3.2: pupphamabhiropayiṁ → pupphamabhipūjayiṁ (bj); puppham abhipūjāyiṁ (pts) | pupphamabhipūjayiṁ → mabhiropayiṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
